name: TOPSTAR Group
name_zh: 广东拓斯达科技股份有限公司
summary:
TOPSTAR develops intelligent manufacturing equipment, robot systems and embodied AI technology. Founded in Dongguan in 2007, the company combines industrial robots, CNC machine tools and injection-molding equipment with controls, servos, machine vision and software.

Its robotics portfolio spans Cartesian, articulated, collaborative and humanoid designs. The company uses industrial processes to guide product development, collecting information from spatial, visual and force sensors to improve robot capabilities. Applications include automotive components, consumer electronics, optics, home appliances and medical manufacturing. Its approach connects robot hardware with the process knowledge and integration services required to introduce intelligent automation into production.
